# anthropic_analytics_users (Data Source)

Per-user activity across chat, Claude Code, Cowork, Claude Design, Office Agent and Science for a Claude Enterprise organization. Data is available from 2026-01-01 with about a one-day lag; the API allows 60 requests per minute per organization. Requires `analytics_api_key` (or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying `read:analytics`).

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Per-user activity for one day, broken out by RBAC group.
data "anthropic_analytics_users" "yesterday" {
  date     = "2026-01-15"
  group_by = ["rbac_group_id"]
}

output "active_chat_users" {
  value = [for r in data.anthropic_analytics_users.yesterday.rows : r.email_address if r.chat_message_count > 0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date` (String) Single UTC day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Exactly one of `date` or `starting_date` must be set.
- `ending_date` (String) Exclusive last day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only valid with `starting_date`; defaults to today.
- `filters` (List of String) Filters as `dimension:value`; repeat a dimension for OR, mix dimensions for AND. Dimensions: `rbac_group_id`, `user_id`, `project_id`.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimensions to break rows out by: `rbac_group_id`.
- `limit_rows` (Number) Maximum number of rows to keep after reading every page. Unlimited when omitted.
- `order` (String) Sort direction, `asc` or `desc`.
- `order_by` (String) Sort field: the endpoint's name column or one of its rankable metrics.
- `starting_date` (String) First day of a range, `YYYY-MM-DD` (rollup mode: one row per entity over the range).

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) One row per user (or per RBAC group when grouped). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))
